_comment: Tracked PLACEHOLDER — it holds no accounts. Real accounts belong in user_configs/credentials/inbound/accounts.json, which takes precedence and is not tracked. Every API consumer token names the account it acts for: a token says which CLIENT is calling, an account on whose BEHALF. An entry is keyed by its account_id (up to 10 characters of a-z, 0-9 and hyphen; 'operator' is reserved for the console) and carries kind (person | service), display_name, active (default true) and note (default empty). Print one to paste with: python python/cli/api_token_cli.py account --id <id> --kind person|service --display-name '<name>'
